description: This PHP source file defines the class PaymentCryptographyClient within the Aws\PaymentCryptography namespace. It extends the AwsClient class and includes method annotations for interacting with the Payment Cryptography Control Plane service, indicating that it functions as a client interface for API calls related to key management and alias operations.
